assets.description: A warm tomato-red hand-sewn running-stitch frame with an empty transparent center.
A cobalt-blue hand-sewn frame with doubled crossing stitches and uneven loops.
A mustard-yellow hand-sewn blanket-stitch frame with short diagonal stitches.

constraints: Keep the borders simple and handmade, with transparent centers and no text or watermark.
Keep the linen texture pale and quiet enough for peacock-green typography to remain readable.
